tool_wheel.configuration.title: Tool Wheel Configuration
tool_wheel.configuration.gameplay.toolti: Gameplay rules such as keeping tool wheel items on death
tool_wheel.configuration.keepBeltOnDeath: Always keep tool wheel & ammo items on death, regardless of the 'keepInventory' game rule.
tool_wheel.configuration.belt.tooltip: Configure the number of tool slots on the wheel (4 - 8)
tool_wheel.configuration.toolSlots.toolt:
Number of tool slots on the wheel (4 - 8, plus 1 dedicated 256-arrow ammo slot).
Reducing it moves items in removed slots back to the inventory (dropped if full).
